steps.title: Placing an order
steps.caption: This walks one request through the shop: from the click in the browser to the row that is stored. Step with → and ← , press Esc to leave.

steps.title: The browser starts it
steps.caption: `placeOrder` posts the cart to `/api/orders`. Nothing is validated on this side, so the server has to.

steps.title: The handler
steps.caption: The whole request body goes straight to the repository, then a `201` is answered. There is no validation here: that is the first thing to add.

steps.title: Where it is stored
steps.caption: The id is the size of the map plus one. Two requests at once could get the same id once this moves to a real database.

steps.title: Billing is not on this flow
steps.caption: The billing service reads the order afterwards, over HTTP. It is a different service, so it is a side card here, not part of the drawn flow.

steps.title: What to check next
steps.caption: Add input validation in `createOrder`, then decide where the invoice should be created.
